short_summary: Looking at a checkout worker alert

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: Right, the checkout worker is throwing again.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: It's probably fine. Checkout retries failed jobs three times anyway.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: Does the worker still retry three times on a 5xx?

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: Two retries seems too low for this kind of failure.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: The events table stores the source IP, so we can trace it back.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: And the new checkout is still disabled in Europe.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: The checkout service is still running 4.12 in production.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: I thought the checkout worker had the DLQ turned off.
